description: This file defines a Swing UI component called ZoomControl that provides zoom in/out buttons, a reset button, and keyboard shortcuts for zooming in a Java application. It manages a zoom level value and notifies a listener on changes.

classes.name: ZoomControl
classes.description: A Swing JPanel component that manages zoom level controls, including buttons and keyboard shortcuts, and notifies a listener when zoom level changes.

methods.name: ZoomControl
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the zoom control UI, including buttons and key bindings.

methods.name: bindKeyStrokeActions
methods.description: Sets up keyboard shortcuts for zoom in and zoom out actions.

methods.name: zoomIn
methods.description: Increases the zoom level by a factor of 1.1.

methods.name: zoomOut
methods.description: Decreases the zoom level by a factor of 1.1.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the zoom level to a specified value and updates the UI accordingly.

methods.name: getZoomProvider
methods.description: Returns an instance of ZoomProvider that supplies the current zoom value.
